items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The time I was out there, the time I took Michael's place--

ctx.x: Tell us a little bit about that. It's very important, the traditional jazz, and in recent months and weeks have been more contemporary jazz at Disneyland. In fact there's been all kinds of jazz at Disneyland. There was even Winston Marsal at Disneyland a couple of weeks ago and some other groups, Spyro Gyro.
The time I was out there, the time I took Michael's place--
